week_objective: Master the acceleration and drive phase: generate maximum force from a standing start and transition smoothly into upright sprinting.
week_skills: Lean into the takeoff (whole body, head down, body low); big arms drive big legs; no side-to-side movement; rise gradually to upright; relax at full speed.
warmup: 10 minutes dynamic warm-up
instructions: Light band or partner resistance for 5-10 m. Emphasise the forward lean, low body position and powerful arm/knee drive.

rest: Walk back; go when fully recovered
instructions: Drive phase only: stay low, head down, aggressive arm action. Feel the lean, drive the knees, pump the arms.
Transition from drive phase to upright running between 10 and 20 m.
Complete acceleration: drive, transition, relaxed top speed. Glutes on, arms and knees ~90°, feet strike under the body.
One sprints while the partner throws a lead pass. Keep sprint form while tracking the disc.

week_objective: Apply the Week 1 acceleration technique from the positions you use in games: standing, layout recovery, forcing and throwing.
week_skills: Spring into position; lean into takeoff; big arms drive the legs; no side-to-side movement; rise gradually.
session_focus: Relay format in groups of 3 (two at the start, one at the finish setting a force). Complete each variation 3 times before moving on.
instructions: Baseline: review all Week 1 cues.
Standard athletic stance.
Start prone. Explode up and forward in one motion; don't stand up first.
Start facing away from the finish. Quick pivot, immediate lean and drive.
Fake the throw, then explode into the sprint.
Throw to the teammate at the finish, then sprint. Release and transition straight to sprint form.

week_objective: Break down the footwork of a 180° change of direction at a controlled pace before adding speed in Week 4.
week_skills: Lean back toward where you are going; wedge step (plant outside foot, load inside foot's outside edge); crossover with full hip extension; getaway step under your centre of gravity.

rest: 1 min between reps; 5 min throwing break between sets
instructions: Cones at 10, 20 and 30 m labelled 1-3. Perfect footwork at each turn; speed comes in Week 4.
Thrower at the start; receive a pass at each turn, stop, throw back, continue. Come to a complete stop before throwing.

week_objective: Apply the Week 3 footwork at higher speeds.
week_skills: Lean into the turn; wedge step and crossover with full hip extension and strong arm drive; explosive getaway step.

reps: 3 left slow, 3 right slow, 6 alternating fast
instructions: Three cones 5 m apart. Shuffle 5 m, turn and sprint 10 m, turn and sprint back 5 m. Perfect technique on slow reps; keep it on fast reps.

rest: 1 min between reps; 5 min after the full sequence
instructions: Keep footwork quality at higher speed.
Receive, stop, throw back, continue. Quick transitions.

week_title: Lateral Movement: Coordination, Reaction and Speed
week_objective: Develop sideways movement, change of direction, reaction time and the move from lateral movement into a sprint.
week_skills: Inside-foot push; outside-foot push with a big crossover and strong getaway step; quick feet without bouncing; big lateral arm drive.
session_focus: Complete the circuit twice: round 1 = "A" variations, round 2 = "B" variations. 5 reps per drill; all 5 drills before resting. Fully recover before round 2.
instructions: Sprint 5 m, shuffle left 3 m, right 6 m, left 3 m, backpedal. B: react to a call or runner.

exercise: Lateral speed ladder (A: two-foot, B: wide spacing)
instructions: Quick, precise foot placement; B lengthens the lateral step.

exercise: Sideways run-out (A: set direction, B: reactive with lead pass)
instructions: 10 m lateral, plant, 10 m sprint. B: sprint on the "up" call and catch a lead pass.
B: hold the outside step for 1 s before re-entry.

exercise: React (A: single change, B: multi change)
instructions: Coloured cones ~5 m apart; sprint to the cone your partner points to.

week_title: Jab Step: Footwork and Quick Redirections

week_skills: Big inside-foot push; high knee drive; strong acceleration angle; getaway step.

exercise: Jab step ladder: slow, fast, high knees
instructions: Jab with the inside foot, drive the knee through, plant and accelerate.

instructions: Forehand fake (right-hander) = left-foot jab; backhand fake = right-foot jab. Mirror race: beat your partner to the line.
